anomalies.observed: On the FCC sheet, the net label VREF+_FCC sits on the left side at pin 13 (PH1) of the STM32H753VITx. Pin 20 (VREF+) has no wire or label on its left side. The VREF+ filter output on the FCC Peripherals/VREF+ filter sheet is also labelled VREF+_FCC.
anomalies.expected: The VREF+ filter output should connect to the MCU's VREF+ pin (pin 20). PH1 is the high-speed external oscillator pin and should not be tied to the reference rail.

evidence.quote: Page 2 (FCC): label "VREF+_FCC" attached to pin 13 "PH1"; pin 20 "VREF+" has no connection drawn on its left side
Page 2 (FCC): "VDDA Filter" / "VREF+ Filter" sheet region, R66 47 and C35/C109 to net "VREF+_FCC"
"Known limitations" does not cover this. Section 2 lists the FCC MCU as STM32H753VITx, and the schematic note reads "VREF+ Filter" beside the VREF+ filter block.

anomalies.impact: The VREF+ reference is not applied to the ADC reference pin, so ADC readings would be wrong or the reference floats. PH1 is shorted to the reference rail, which can stop the 25 MHz HSE crystal from oscillating and prevent the FCC from clocking correctly.

parsed.summary: The FCC sheet appears to tie the VREF+ filter net to PH1 (the HSE oscillator pin) while the MCU's VREF+ pin 20 is left unconnected. This is a likely wiring error, but the drawing is dense and the label placement is not fully unambiguous, so confidence is moderate.
